name: dsaireadable
description: The DSAIReadable design system for agents: its MCP server and the skills that change and review UI with it.

plugins.name: dsaireadable
plugins.description: The DSAIReadable design system's MCP server, which builds React screens with it, and two skills: dsaireadable-build keeps a change to an existing screen in line with the system, dsaireadable-ui-guard reviews a screen for basic UI and UX errors on request.
